methods.name: createApplication
methods.desc: Create the contract with initial configuration

methods.name: updateMinStakeGateways
methods.desc: Update minimum stake requirement for gateways (admin only)

methods.name: updateMaxGateways
methods.desc: Update maximum gateways allowed (admin only)

methods.name: updateHeartbeatInterval
methods.desc: Update heartbeat interval (admin only)

methods.name: transferAdmin
methods.desc: Transfer admin to new address (admin only)

methods.name: registerGateway
methods.desc:
Register a gateway with endpoint and public key
Requires payment transaction for stake + MBR for box storage

methods.name: updateEndpoint
methods.desc: Update gateway endpoint (gateway owner only)

methods.name: updatePublicKey
methods.desc: Update gateway public key (gateway owner only)

methods.name: addStake
methods.desc:
Add additional stake to existing registration
Requires payment transaction

methods.name: withdrawStake
methods.desc:
Withdraw stake
Can withdraw to minimum or full amount (which deregisters)

methods.name: heartbeat
methods.desc: Heartbeat to prove gateway is alive and update uptime

methods.name: suspendGateway
methods.desc: Suspend a gateway (admin only)

methods.name: reactivateGateway
methods.desc: Reactivate a suspended gateway (admin only)

methods.name: banGateway
methods.desc: Ban a gateway and slash stake (admin only)

methods.name: isGatewayActive
methods.desc: Check if gateway is active (registered and recently sent heartbeat)

methods.name: getGatewayEndpoint
methods.desc: Get gateway endpoint

methods.name: getGatewayPublicKey
methods.desc: Get gateway public key

methods.name: getGatewayStake
methods.desc: Get gateway stake amount

methods.name: getGatewayStatus
methods.desc: Get gateway status

methods.name: getTotalGateways
methods.desc: Get total registered gateways

methods.name: getGatewayByIndex
methods.desc: Get gateway address by index (for discovery/enumeration)
